bant.notes: Board-approved modernization budget. CTO sponsors, but SBP observation letter is the real forcing function, not the ELA date.

meddpicc.notes: Decision criteria shaped around sovereignty, DR posture, and audit evidence. Procurement runs a formal RFP. VMware incumbent will defend; Nutanix invited.

business.outcomes: A sovereign, audit-ready private platform across DC and DR that satisfies SBP observations on outsourcing and data residency, de-risks the 2027 VMware renewal, and hosts the digital banking channel containers currently straining the incumbent stack.
business.constraints: SBP audit cycle closes Q2 2027. No production changes during Ramadan freeze. All data and management planes must remain in-country.
business.budget_range: Board-approved envelope, not disclosed; directional 3–5M USD over 5 years
business.success_criteria: SBP observations closed, RPO 15 min / RTO 4 h evidenced in DR drill, digital channel releases weekly instead of monthly

stakeholders.name: Nadia Qureshi
stakeholders.notes: Sponsor. Wants one platform answer for VMs and the digital channel containers.

stakeholders.notes: Drove the OpenShift evaluation. Needs help defending subscription costs to the CFO.

stakeholders.name: Bilal Ahmed

stakeholders.name: Khalid Mirza
stakeholders.notes: Views this as cost expansion. TCO must show renewal avoidance plus consolidation, in USD with PKR sensitivity.

estate.storage_platform: vSAN across DC and DR, NetApp NAS for shared files
estate.databases: Oracle Exadata (core banking adjacent), SQL Server, MongoDB for channels

workloads.name: Core banking periphery (T24 satellites)
workloads.notes: Vendor-certified stack, stays as VMs on dedicated nodes.

workloads.name: Digital banking channels
workloads.notes: Already containerized on an unsupported DIY Kubernetes, needs an enterprise platform.

workloads.name: Payments & middleware (MQ, ESB)
workloads.notes: Middleware team open to containerizing ESB flows in phase 2.

workloads.name: Dev/test & UAT
workloads.notes: First wave. UAT parity with production required by internal audit.

technical.pain_points: SBP observation on cloud outsourcing and residency evidence. DIY Kubernetes for digital channels has no vendor support and failed a DR test. VMware renewal expected to double under subscription model. NSX skills concentrated in two engineers. Release windows monthly, digital team needs weekly.

growth.notes: Digital channel growth plus branch expansion; container estate expected to triple by 2029.

vmware.pain: No renewal quote yet, but peer banks report 80–150% uplifts moving to VCF subscription. NSX and SRM entitlements are the lock-in concern. Broadcom account coverage has changed twice in a year.

assumptions.text: 850 total VMs across DC and DR from CMDB extract; powered-on figure 790 used for sizing
VMware renewal uplift of 100% used as planning midpoint until a real quote arrives
SBP residency requirement applies to management plane as well as data plane
assumptions.source: CISO interpretation of SBP outsourcing framework, to be confirmed with compliance
